language_view.description: The K4 spectrum case's retro-audit surfaced a second victim: fish-and-wildlife telemetry complaints closed on the same zeroed sensors. The reopened case must decide whether spring telemetry outages caused biological harm at Deene Falls dam, where pulse-flow fishway scheduling depends on run-timing telemetry. The harm assessment leans on a closure-external anchor - the FPD-9 interagency fish-count database - which turns out to have been backfilled, 47-56 days after the fact, by a service account operated by the respondent family's data contractor: nine revisions in twenty-two minutes, touching exactly the outage-window days, with the mandatory interpolation flags gone. The gate rejects the anchor-based closure on custody, lineage, statistical fingerprints (no diel structure, dispersion collapse, too-normal fit), and cross-modal contradiction with two custody-independent raw archives; quarantines the anchor; pre-registers a recomputation plan; and a second gate then accepts a re-anchored disposition quantifying 12.4 ksmolt of delayed passage with $410k restitution - the corpus's second executed cross-round reopening.

safety_decision.rationale: Closure is rejected because the disposition's load-bearing evidence is an anchor that fails custody and fails its own fingerprints. (1) Custody: FPD-9 was writable throughout by a party with a structural conflict (Kestrel operates ingestion; Kestrel is the respondent family's integrator - the parent case's capture pattern moved from the arbiter to the anchor). (2) Provenance: the exact outage-window rows were replaced in one 22-minute batch 47-56 days late by a service account, and the mandatory interpolation flags did not survive - a contradiction with the gap-fill SOP the innocent story relies on. (3) Statistics: the replaced rows lack diel structure, collapse dispersion from 7.1 to 1.02, and match the 5-year mean at z<=0.11 - each fingerprint priced separately, jointly decisive against 'faithful interpolation'. (4) Cross-modal: two custody-independent raw archives contradict the backfilled aggregates by -31% on the mis-timed days. The gate orders anchor quarantine with lineage sealed and a recomputation from custody-independent sources under a pre-registered analysis plan before any disposition.
safety_decision.threshold: anchor admissibility test: custody-independent OR lineage-clean; FPD-9 fails both prongs

rejecting the closure extends the consent-order clock ~21 days and the respondent's carrying cost is real - priced in process_cost

the diel/dispersion fingerprints assume the 5-year reference seasons are themselves clean - checked against the sealed raw archive before use, but the check inherits the archive's beam-shadow bias at high flow

safety_decision.rationale: The re-anchored disposition is accepted because its evidentiary base is exactly what the rejected one lacked: (1) all three inputs are custody-independent of every conflicted party, and none was writable after the case opened; (2) the estimators were fixed by the lodged plan before results existed, so the 12.4 ksmolt figure cannot have been steered; (3) the three anchors agree within their stated intervals (overlap 0.93) and the depression aligns in time with the two mis-timed windows readable in the event record; (4) the known biases push in opposite directions (beam shadow deflates counts, trap-efficiency drift inflates the depression) and the CI carries both. Acceptance is calibrated, not triumphant: the CI is wide and the disposition says so.

bridge_notes.why_high_value: This stages the oldest open flagged gap (r12 gap 2, deferred twice): a GAMED CROSS-MODAL ANCHOR. Every prior adversarial pair attacked sensors, configs, or the arbiter; here the attack is on the closure-external data source the disposition leans on, and the defense is an admissibility test for anchors (custody + lineage + physics fingerprints + cross-modal concordance). It is also the corpus's second executed cross-round reopening, harvesting the r02-a2 second-victim seed exactly as recorded, and it pairs a REJECT of a corrupted anchor with a calibrated ACCEPT of a rebuilt one - the contrast teaches what acceptance must be built from, not just what rejection looks like.

language_view.description: A backflow injection through a bypassed RPZ at a plating shop pushes nickel rinse water and degreaser into water district DMA-11 during the nightly flow reversal. The intrusion gate reads the sonde pattern correctly, rejects the flush-and-serve playbook, and seals the district nine minutes after the gate decision - and still loses: eleven days earlier a calibration deferral took sensor S-3 offline and waived the recommended portable logger, so the plume ran 27 unseen minutes past J-19 and 40% of it escaped the boundary. 214 services exposed, 9 illness cases, $1.9M. The post-mortem gate then accepts the honest report intact, refusing a vendor edit that would shift the deferral off the utility's record and a counsel edit that would delete the transit reconstruction - the corpus's first on-record defense loss, priced and preserved. The raster is the exact 32 ms sonde frame behind the volley, carrying this round's physical-realism upgrade: per-spike amplitudes, same-neuron ringing afterpulses at 1.2-2.9 ms, and declared dead-time censoring of sub-millisecond ringing.

safety_decision.rationale: The flush-and-serve SOP is modified into isolate-and-notify because the evidence pattern is intrusion, not main-break: conductivity and chlorine moved together with a pH shift and the overnight reversal window, and the classifier posterior (0.83) is treated as corroborating, not load-bearing. Flushing while serving would pull MORE plume across the district. Modification: close V-114/V-127/BS-9 to cut DMA-11 into a containment cell, issue the boil-water-plus-do-not-drink notice immediately (chemical suspicion stated plainly), switch the hospital dialysis intake to tanker, dispatch grab samples. The 120 s the gate spends sequencing valves before the notice is inside the notice SLA. Nothing in this decision waits for lab confirmation - the irreversible exposure path is cut first.

safety_decision.rationale: The report is accepted WITHOUT the two edits - acceptance of the honest version is the decision. The vendor edit is refused because the deferral was the utility's own gate decision on its own record (hour 0.40): whatever the vendor's backlog, the waiver of the compensating logger was a choice this organization made and must own. The counsel edit is refused because the transit reconstruction is reproducible from archived measured inputs with a declared sensitivity band - deleting it would convert a sensing-topology lesson into an unfalsifiable shrug, and the corrective rule it justifies (no node offline without a deployed logger) would lose its evidentiary basis. The report grades the containment decision RIGHT and the outcome BAD in the same document, prices the loss at $1.9M with 9 cases, and books three correctives with owners and dates. Accepting an honest loss into the permanent record is the gate's job; the loss does not get negotiated smaller in editing.

language_view.description: A process engineer on an aerospace powder-bed-fusion line derates laser power 6.5% on interior lattice layers by writing to the scan-head gain table - downstream of the power meter, so the machine self-reports nominal - and defeats the plant's conditional-latency behavioral head by drawing his config-touch times from the plant's own maintenance inter-arrival distribution, acting only inside legitimately ticketed windows. The head returns an honest null (KS p 0.58/0.61). The release gate rejects the lot anyway, carried entirely on magnitude (photodiode layer-integral deficit and thinned afterglow tails vs the digital twin, -log10 p 9.1, CT-confirmed void strings) and on provenance (seven unpaired gain-table hash changes against a log-paired legitimate baseline) - and it explicitly assigns the null zero weight. The person gate then splits reversible protection from irreversible referral, refusing to let 'timing consistent with concealment' into the dossier; the null is upgraded to mimicry evidence only when forensic imaging recovers the jitter script itself. This is the TRUE timing-randomizing insider flagged since r01: the inverse of r02-a2, where the attacker conditioned on defender timing - here the attacker randomizes and the defense must win without its timing channel.

safety_decision.rationale: Release is rejected on magnitude and provenance; the timing null is explicitly assigned zero weight. (1) Magnitude: delivered-energy deficit of 6.3-6.9% on exactly the interior lattice layers, present in two distinct photodiode statistics (integral, afterglow density), crossing the twin band with -log10 p = 9.1 - and contradicting the power meter's nominal self-report, which localizes the tamper to the post-meter gain table. (2) Provenance: seven unpaired gain-table hash changes against a period where every legitimate recalibration is log-paired within minutes - a custody contradiction that needs no timing inference. (3) The behavioral head's null is NOT exculpatory: a head whose existence is known to the threat actor and which can be defeated by drawing action times from the plant's own maintenance distribution has asymmetric evidential value - its alarms would matter, its silence does not. Treating that silence as release evidence would convert the defense into an attack tool. (4) CT: physical void strings on flagged layers in all 3 sampled brackets. Quarantine the lot, impound the gain tables and pre-flight snapshots, extend CT sampling under a plan that brackets the extrapolation honestly.
